name: godot
notes: **Windows gotcha (confirmed by testing):** Godot's Windows zip ships a plain GUI-subsystem exe and a `_console` variant. The plain build opens a window but its stdout is NOT reliably capturable by a script; the console build's is, and it opens a normal game window too without `--headless`. So the launcher forwards to the console build. That build also refuses to run if renamed ("Invalid wrapper executable name"), which is why the launcher forwards to it instead of aliasing it.
**`--headless` matters for `--version`:** without it Godot tries to init a graphical context before printing.

**macOS:** the release is an app bundle (`Godot.app`) shipped as one universal build for Intel and Apple Silicon. The bundle is kept whole and the launcher runs the program inside it, so every documented command works the same on every platform.

commands.title: Import / script-error check (what CI runs before tests)
commands.note: Then check the output for `SCRIPT ERROR` - a hit means fail; don't eyeball it. A fresh checkout has no `.godot/` cache, so global `class_name` lookups fail until one full import pass runs.

commands.title: Launch the actual game window (real play-testing)
commands.note: From a Claude Code session, launch as a background task and have the user interact and report back. **Check for an already-running instance first** (`tasklist //FI "IMAGENAME eq Godot*"` on Windows) and surface a stale one to the user rather than launching a duplicate.
